_meta.description: Human-reviewed PAN service cards. Facts here are shown verbatim in the UI, so every fee/step must be checked against the cited official source. 'verify' = figure seen on official/secondary sources but must be re-confirmed on the payment screen.
_meta.notice: From 1 April 2026 the Income-tax Act 2025 is in force and PAN 2.0 is being rolled out; form numbers (49A/49AA) and portals may change. The crawler flags changed source pages for review.
_meta.fee_policy: Fees are quoted only when stated on an official government/agency service page (source URL on each fee). Otherwise the UI says the fee is shown on the official payment page.

services.title: Get a new PAN instantly (free e-PAN)
services.short: Free, paperless PAN in minutes using your Aadhaar OTP
eligibility: Indian resident individual with a valid Aadhaar
Mobile number linked with Aadhaar (for OTP)
You have never been allotted a PAN
You are not a minor on the date of application

not_for.when: You are a minor, NRI/foreign citizen, company, firm or trust
You already have a PAN but lost it

documents: Aadhaar number (details are taken from Aadhaar e-KYC — no uploads)
services.time: Usually a few minutes; e-PAN PDF is emailed and downloadable from the portal

steps.title: Open Instant e-PAN
steps.detail: On the Income Tax e-filing portal choose Instant e-PAN → Get New e-PAN.

steps.title: Enter Aadhaar and confirm
steps.detail: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar, tick the confirmation and accept the terms.

steps.title: Verify OTP
steps.detail: Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile.

steps.title: Validate Aadhaar details
steps.detail: Your name, DOB, gender and address are pulled from Aadhaar. Optionally validate your email ID.

steps.title: Submit and note acknowledgement
steps.detail: Save the acknowledgement number shown. Use it to check status / download e-PAN later.

tips: Your PAN will carry exactly the details in Aadhaar — fix Aadhaar first if anything is wrong there.
e-PAN is a legally valid PAN. If you also want a physical card, order a reprint later.
common_rejections: Mobile number not linked to Aadhaar (OTP never arrives)
Applicant already holds a PAN (holding two PANs is an offence)
Date of birth incomplete in Aadhaar (only year of birth)

services.title: Apply for a new PAN card (physical card / special cases)
services.short: Form-based PAN application via Protean or UTIITSL — for minors, NRIs, companies or anyone wanting a physical card
eligibility: Anyone who has never been allotted a PAN
Indian citizens (Form 49A) or foreign citizens/entities (Form 49AA) — forms may be renamed under the Income-tax Act 2025; follow the form the portal shows
Minors apply through a parent/guardian representative

not_for.when: Adult Indian resident with Aadhaar linked to mobile who only needs a PAN quickly

documents: Proof of identity (e.g. Aadhaar, passport, voter ID, driving licence)
Proof of address (e.g. Aadhaar, passport, bank statement, utility bill not older than 3 months)
Proof of date of birth (e.g. Aadhaar, birth certificate, matriculation certificate, passport)
Recent colour photograph and signature (if applying with physical/scanned documents)
For minors: representative assessee's (parent's) ID and address proof

fees.label: Application fee (physical card or e-PAN only; India or abroad)
fees.amount: Shown on the official payment page before you pay
fees.note: The exact fee depends on the options you choose and is displayed by Protean/UTIITSL on their payment step. CivicRoute does not quote third-party figures.

services.time: Not stated on the official page — track status online with your acknowledgement number

steps.title: Pick a portal
steps.detail: Protean (NSDL) or UTIITSL — both are official. Choose one and stay on it for the whole application.

steps.title: Choose application type & category
steps.detail: New PAN – Indian Citizen (or Foreign Citizen) and the category (Individual, Company, Firm, HUF, Trust…).

steps.title: Choose submission mode
steps.detail: Paperless (Aadhaar e-KYC + e-Sign, cheapest) or physical documents (scan upload or courier).

steps.title: Fill personal, contact and address details
steps.detail: Name exactly as in your ID proof. Father's name is mandatory for individuals (mother's name optional).

steps.title: Upload photo, signature and proofs
steps.detail: Only if not using full e-KYC. Check size limits before uploading.

steps.title: Pay the fee
steps.detail: Pay on the portal's own payment page (UPI / net banking / card / demand draft). Never pay on a third-party page.

steps.title: e-Sign or courier documents
steps.detail: Authenticate with Aadhaar OTP/e-Sign, or send signed acknowledgement + documents to the address printed on it within 15 days.

steps.title: Save acknowledgement number
steps.detail: 15-digit acknowledgement (Protean) or coupon number (UTIITSL) — needed to track status.

tips: Name, DOB and father's name must match your proof documents letter-for-letter — mismatch is the #1 reason for rejection.
Paperless mode (Aadhaar e-KYC + e-Sign) avoids couriering documents.
common_rejections: Name/DOB on form differs from the proof document
Photo or signature unclear, wrong size, or signature outside the box
Physical documents not received within 15 days

services.title: Correct or change details on your PAN
services.short: Fix name, date of birth, father's name, photo, signature, gender, address or contact details
eligibility: Anyone who already has a PAN and needs any detail changed

not_for.when: Details are correct and you just lost/damaged the card

documents: Copy of PAN (or PAN number) as proof of PAN
Proof of identity and address and date of birth (as for a new PAN)
Proof supporting the change: e.g. marriage certificate / gazette notification for name change, birth certificate / matriculation certificate for DOB
Photo and signature if updating them (physical/scan mode)

fees.label: Application fee (physical card or e-PAN only; India or abroad)
fees.amount: Shown on the official payment page before you pay
fees.note: The exact fee depends on the options you choose and is displayed by Protean/UTIITSL on their payment step. CivicRoute does not quote third-party figures.

services.time: Not stated on the official page — track status online with your acknowledgement number

steps.title: Open the change/correction application
steps.detail: On Protean choose Application Type → 'Changes or Correction in existing PAN Data / Reprint of PAN Card'. UTIITSL has an equivalent 'Change/Correction in PAN Card details'.

steps.title: Enter PAN and register
steps.detail: Fill category, name, DOB, email, mobile and your PAN. Note the token number you get.

steps.title: Tick ONLY the fields you want to change
steps.detail: Each field has a checkbox on its left. Fill all fields, but tick only the ones being corrected.

steps.title: Upload proofs
steps.detail: Attach proof for the changed field plus identity/address/DOB proof.

steps.title: Pay on the official payment page
steps.detail: Use the portal's own payment gateway.

steps.title: e-Sign or courier documents
steps.detail: Aadhaar e-Sign (paperless) or post the signed acknowledgement with documents within 15 days.

steps.title: Track using the acknowledgement number
steps.detail: Status is visible on the Protean/UTIITSL tracking page.

tips: If Aadhaar already has the correct details, paperless e-KYC is fastest — the PAN will mirror Aadhaar.
Individuals whose Aadhaar is correct can also use 'Update PAN' under Instant e-PAN on the Income Tax portal to update PAN details as per Aadhaar e-KYC (check current availability on the portal).
For a surname change after marriage, keep the marriage certificate or gazette notification ready.
Your PAN number never changes — only the details on it.
common_rejections: Field ticked for change but no supporting proof uploaded
New name doesn't match the proof document
Name in Aadhaar differs from the requested name (paperless mode uses Aadhaar data)

services.title: Get a duplicate / reprint of your PAN card
services.short: Lost, stolen or damaged card — same PAN, same details, new card delivered
eligibility: You already have a PAN and none of the details need changing
Aadhaar-based OTP verification requires PAN–Aadhaar linking

not_for.when: Any detail (name, DOB, address…) must change
A PDF copy is enough (it's legally valid)

documents: PAN number
Date of birth
Aadhaar (for OTP) — must be linked to the PAN
services.time: Not stated on the official page — track the dispatch status online with your acknowledgement number

steps.title: Find out which agency issued your PAN
steps.detail: Use the portal that issued your PAN/last update (Protean or UTIITSL). If unsure, try Protean first — it tells you if the PAN was processed elsewhere.

steps.title: Open 'Reprint of PAN Card'
steps.detail: Enter PAN, Aadhaar (individuals) and date of birth, accept the declaration.

steps.title: Choose OTP destination
steps.detail: OTP goes to the mobile/email registered with the Income Tax Department.

steps.title: Pay the reprint fee
steps.detail: Pay on the portal's own payment page.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.detail: The card is posted to the communication address in the latest ITD records. To deliver elsewhere, you must apply for change/correction instead.

tips: The delivery address cannot be changed in a reprint — it uses the address in the latest ITD records.
Need it today? Download the e-PAN PDF; it is as valid as the physical card.
If your card was stolen, consider filing a police complaint in case of misuse.
common_rejections: PAN not linked with Aadhaar (OTP fails)
Mobile/email in ITD records is outdated (OTP never arrives) — update via correction

services.title: Download your e-PAN (PDF)
services.short: e-PAN email not received, or you need a digital copy right now
documents: PAN or acknowledgement number
Date of birth
Aadhaar (for some flows)

fees.label: Protean: PAN allotted/changed in the last 30 days

steps.title: If you got PAN via Instant e-PAN
steps.detail: Income Tax portal → Instant e-PAN → Check Status/Download PAN → Aadhaar + OTP.

steps.title: If PAN was issued by Protean (NSDL)
steps.detail: Use 'Download e-PAN / e-PAN XML' with your PAN or acknowledgement number.

steps.title: If PAN was issued by UTIITSL
steps.detail: Use UTIITSL's e-PAN download service.

steps.title: Open the PDF
steps.detail: The e-PAN PDF is usually password-protected with your date of birth in DDMMYYYY format.

tips: Didn't get the e-PAN email? Check spam, and confirm the email registered with ITD — you may need a correction to update it.
The PDF password is your date of birth as DDMMYYYY.
common_rejections: Trying the wrong agency's portal for your PAN

services.title: Link PAN with Aadhaar / fix an inoperative PAN
services.short: PAN inoperative, bank/ITR blocked, or you need to link Aadhaar
eligibility: PAN holders who are not in an exempted category

not_for.when: Name/DOB mismatch between PAN and Aadhaar stops linking

documents: PAN
Aadhaar number
Mobile number for OTP

fees.label: Late linking fee (e-Pay Tax, 'Other Receipts (500)')
fees.amount: ₹1,000 — pre-filled by the e-Pay Tax page
fees.note: The amount is pre-filled on the official e-Pay Tax challan; pay exactly what it shows.

services.time: Wait 4–5 working days after paying before submitting the link request; PAN typically becomes operative within ~30 days of linking

steps.title: Check current status first
steps.detail: Income Tax portal → Link Aadhaar Status. If already linked, nothing to do.

steps.title: Pay the late fee
steps.detail: Link Aadhaar → enter PAN & Aadhaar → 'Continue to Pay Through e-Pay Tax' → OTP → Income Tax tile → choose Assessment Year and 'Other Receipts (500)' → pay at your bank.

steps.title: Wait for payment to reflect
steps.detail: Allow 4–5 working days for the challan to be verified.

steps.title: Submit the link request
steps.detail: Link Aadhaar → PAN + Aadhaar → Validate → confirm name as per Aadhaar → OTP.

steps.title: Re-check status
steps.detail: Use Link Aadhaar Status until it shows linked.

tips: Name, DOB and gender must match between PAN and Aadhaar. If they don't, correct PAN (or Aadhaar) first.
If your Aadhaar is linked to a different PAN, contact your Jurisdictional Assessing Officer (Know Your AO on the portal).
common_rejections: Demographic mismatch between PAN and Aadhaar
Link request submitted before the fee payment was verified

official_links.label: How to link Aadhaar (official user manual)

services.title: Track your PAN application
services.short: Applied already? See where your PAN or card is
eligibility: Anyone who has submitted a PAN application
documents: 15-digit acknowledgement number (Protean) or coupon number (UTIITSL), or Instant e-PAN acknowledgement

steps.title: Protean (NSDL) applications
steps.detail: Application type 'PAN – New/Change Request' + acknowledgement number.

steps.title: UTIITSL applications
steps.detail: Enter coupon number or PAN.

steps.title: Instant e-PAN
steps.detail: Instant e-PAN → Check Status/Download PAN.

steps.title: Once dispatched
steps.detail: The status page shows the India Post consignment number — track it on India Post.

tips: Save your acknowledgement number in CivicRoute's tracker so you never lose it.

services.title: Verify a PAN / find your PAN details
services.short: Check a PAN is valid and active, or confirm the name and status on it
documents: PAN, full name, date of birth, mobile for OTP

steps.title: Open Verify Your PAN
steps.detail: Income Tax portal → Quick Links → Verify Your PAN.

steps.title: Enter details and OTP
steps.detail: PAN, full name, DOB and a mobile number for OTP.

steps.title: Read the result
steps.detail: Shows whether the PAN is active and the details match.

tips: Forgot your PAN number? If PAN is linked to Aadhaar, the e-PAN download via Instant e-PAN (Aadhaar OTP) shows it.

services.title: Surrender an extra (duplicate) PAN
services.short: You have two PAN numbers — keep one, surrender the other
eligibility: Anyone who has been allotted more than one PAN

not_for.when: You only lost your card (one PAN number)

documents: The PAN you will keep
The PAN(s) to surrender (number / copy)
Identity proof

fees.label: Change/correction application used to surrender
fees.amount: Shown on the official payment page before you pay

fees.label: Penalty risk for holding more than one PAN (Income-tax law)

steps.title: Decide which PAN to keep
steps.detail: Keep the one used for bank accounts, ITRs and Aadhaar linking.

steps.title: Apply via change/correction form
steps.detail: On Protean/UTIITSL's change/correction application, mention the PAN(s) to be surrendered in the 'other PANs' section and attach copies.

steps.title: Or write to your Assessing Officer
steps.detail: Send a letter with both PAN details to your Jurisdictional AO.

tips: Act quickly — holding two PANs can attract a penalty.
common_rejections: Other PAN not mentioned / no copy attached
